info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchandising Loan Management API
info.description: The Merchandising Loan Management API enables users to update and manage existing merchandising loan records efficiently. This API facilitates modifications to loan details, catering to businesses looking to adjust loan terms or specific attributes as needed. Typical consumers include banking services, financial institutions, and retail companies that require flexible loan management capabilities. The API supports a seamless experience for users by allowing quick updates via the PATCH method for specific loan identifiers.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific merchandising loan identified by its loan ID. Submit the necessary changes in the request body to modify the loan attributes as needed.

requestBody.description: Update the details of the merchandising loan identified by LOAN-500045. This request body allows clients to submit modifications to specific fields of the loan, ensuring that all updates conform to the expected structure defined in the schema.
